name: register-jumps
of: A mechanism by which a live situation is moved from one register to another, a register being the rules for who may speak, what counts as a move, and what closes the matter, named with the carrier of the jump (a word, a room, a document, a witness, a delay, a body, a question), what the new register can do that the old could not, what is lost in transit, and whose hand the carrier is in: the weaker party's alone, the weaker party's to propose and the room's to complete, an institution's to lend, or the room-holder's only.
items: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since no room may continue its business past an unattended body; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; the one register entrance no permission can deny to the weakest party, and unlike the fire alarm, which anyone may pull and which a fine guards, this one is guarded by the discount every later collapse suffers.

Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted and so cannot be paid out; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.

Get back to you: a live negotiation becomes an asynchronous one when the weaker party leaves with the offer, as a patient tells the surgeon 'I'll think about it' or a candidate takes the offer letter home; the new register admits consultation, writing, and a second reader, and strips the room of the advantage its holder had from being present, at the cost of the offer that expires at the door and the momentum a live yes would have carried; not the statutory cooling-off period, which is a delay granted, but a delay taken, and the holder's 'I need an answer now' is the tell that the room was the holder's whole edge.

Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.

The room's laugh: a claim becomes survivable when it is delivered as a joke and the room laughs, as a junior surgeon's 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' says what a memo could not; the new register lets the unsayable be said in the presence of the party it is about and cannot be answered as a claim, since whoever answers becomes the one who could not take a joke, and what is lost is the remedy, because a joker who later presses the claim seems to renege on the laugh; not low-chair-advantages' Fool's license, which is a standing discount on a chair, but a discount applied to one sentence and paid for by the room, so the jump is proposed by the weaker party and completed by the room, and a joke nobody laughs at lands as a claim, and a worse one; 'only joking' runs the same carrier backward after the room has answered.

If you were my mother: a medical question becomes a family one when kinship is put into the sentence, as a patient asks the oncologist 'what would you do if it were your mother,' and the oncologist, who may not choose for a patient, may choose for a mother; the new register permits a recommendation with a person behind it, and what is lost is the denominator, since the mother has no survival curve, and the patient's authorship of the choice, which the kin register quietly takes over; not the employer's 'we're a family here,' which moves a relation rather than a question and imports unbounded obligation into a contract, and a jump the patient can ask for but only the clinician can complete, since the answer is the register.

In writing: an oral exchange becomes a record when the weaker party asks for it on paper, as a tenant answers a landlord's assurance with 'could you put that in an email'; the new register binds both to a text rather than to whichever memory the room will believe, and what is lost is speed, the goodwill of a party who reads the request as an accusation, and the asker's own room to stay vague; not the lawyer's letter, which changes the forum and prices every subsequent move, and the jump completes only if the stronger party writes, so 'let's keep this between us' is the refusal's native form.

Bring a friend: a conversation becomes a proceeding when a third body enters the room, as an employee brings a steward to a meeting the manager called a chat, or a child's presence turns a parents' quarrel into a performance for the child; the new register makes every sentence testimony, so offers that could not be repeated are not made and pressure that needs privacy stops, and what is lost is candor and the off-the-record settlement privacy allowed; not a witness kept for later proof, which is In writing's work, but a change in what can be said now, and the inverse jump, switching to a language the third body cannot follow, restores the private register without anyone leaving.

Duel's seconds: a quarrel becomes a ceremony when both parties accept seconds, as the code duello gave the challenged party the choice of weapons and the whole affair a field, an hour, a count, and a sentence that ends it, 'honor is satisfied'; the new register has a terminus, which a fight does not, and hands the challenged party options the fight would never give, and what is lost is winning, since the form fixes much of the outcome before anyone arrives, and the grievance, which the ceremony consumes without addressing; not sport, which is entered for its own sake, but a proceeding entered to end something, and a jump neither party can make alone, since one second is a witness and two are a rule.

Wallet away: a purchase becomes a gift when payment is refused, as a mechanic waves off the bill for a neighbor's brake job; the new register opens a relation the paid bill would have closed, since a gift has no paper that says settled and therefore no end, and what is lost is the price, which told both parties what the work was worth, and the payer's freedom to leave square, since the only way to close a gift is to insult it; the reverse of what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor, adding the door that opens, and a jump only the party owed can make, since a payment forced past a refusal is read as rejecting the relation the refusal offered.

Let the number say it: a contested decision becomes a measurement when someone proposes a test, as an engineer answers an executive's design preference with 'let's A/B it'; the new register settles the matter without a loser, since the number decided, and moves the decision into the room the proposer holds, and what is lost is everything the metric does not measure and the vote of anyone who cannot read the number; not evidence brought to a decision, which stays in the decisional register, but the replacement of the decision by a reading, and a low-chair jump only where the low chair owns the instrument.

Grievance stamp: a hurt becomes a case when the contract's word for it is applied, as a steward tells a worker 'that's not a complaint, that's a grievance' and the matter acquires a form, a deadline, a ladder of steps, and a list of remedies; the new register can be filed, timed, escalated, and won by someone who could not win the argument, and what does not survive transit is the hurt, which no step addresses, and the worker's own voice, which now speaks through the steward; not a renaming for effect, since the word works only where a clause already says what it triggers, so the weaker party can make this jump exactly where someone stronger once wrote it in.

Call the police: a family or commercial dispute becomes a crime when a report is filed, as a bookkeeper's unrepaid loan becomes embezzlement on a police form; the new register brings in a party neither side controls, one that can jail and that no longer needs the complainant's consent, and what is lost is control, since in many jurisdictions the complainant cannot drop what the state has picked up, and the money, which criminal courts restore badly; the heaviest jump the weaker party can make alone and the one that cannot be walked back, unlike the letterhead, which prices every move but leaves the complainant holding the case.

Written for the future court: a lost argument becomes an open one when the loser writes to a reader who is not in the room, as a judge's dissent addresses a court that does not yet exist and a fired officer's memorandum to file addresses an inquiry that may never be held; the new register cannot be answered by the present majority, since its addressee is absent, and what is lost is any effect now and often the loser's standing in the room, where they are seen to have stopped arguing with it; not Told, not claimed, which stays in the room and asks for sympathy, but the one jump reserved to the party who has already lost, and it works only where an archive outlives the room.

Whose desk: a failure with a mechanism becomes a failure with an owner when the room asks who owned it, as a postmortem on a race condition ends with a name and a reorganization; the new register can close today, since a person can be assigned where a mechanism cannot, and what is lost is the mechanism, which recurs under the new owner; not the request for a decision, which moves a question from fact to choice, but a move from cause to person, made by whoever holds the meeting, and run backward by the engineer who answers a staffing question with 'we need a tool.'

Policy says: a personal refusal becomes a categorical one when the manual is produced, as the clerk who cannot say no to a face says 'the policy doesn't allow it'; the new register refuses without insult and applies to everyone equally, and what is lost is the exception, the discretion that could have helped, and the human read of the case; a jump only the holder of the manual can make, and the weaker party's return move, 'let me speak to someone who can decide,' works only where a chair of discretion still exists above the manual, which the manual is often written to abolish.

Feelings clinic: a claim becomes a feeling when it is received as one, as a manager answers 'the schedule is unsafe' with 'I hear that you're feeling stressed'; the new register cannot be wrong and cannot bind, so the room is safe and nothing follows from it, and what is lost is the claim's purchase on the world and the standing of the claimant, who has become a patient; not the diagnosis, which moves an act into pathology, can confine without trial, and can be invoked by the accused as well, but a jump the room-holder makes on the claimant's sentence, and the claimant's counter, restating the feeling as a number or a document, is Let the number say it or In writing entered from below.

One-way fine: a moral obligation becomes a purchasable option when a fee is attached, as in the well-known daycare study, simplified here, where fining late parents produced more late parents, since the fine told them lateness had a price and the price was affordable; the new register lets the obligation be bought instead of honored, and what is lost is the guilt that was doing the enforcing, which in that study did not return when the fine was removed; what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor names the exit from the gift register, and this item adds that the door does not reopen, a hysteresis observed once and generalized here only as a speculation; the jump is the room-holder's and, unlike Wallet away, runs one way.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: stewards and grievance clauses, tenants asking for email, police reports, seconds and the code duello, dissents and memoranda to file, daycare fines, traffic stops, ward-round jokes, oncology consultations; drawn from labor, law, medicine, family, engineering, and trade.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism; One-way fine rests on a single well-known field study and its generalization is marked speculative in the item and in the edge from Wallet away; every other item is analytical about a recognizable practice, with no claim about the specific histories named.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real situation usually undergoes several jumps at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every register or every carrier.
The seriation is an itinerary of whose hand the carrier is in, not a ranking of power, cost, or how often each jump is made; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the code duello, the daycare fine, the traffic-stop question, the judicial dissent, the steward's grievance) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; One-way fine rests on a single well-known field study, and its generalization to other priced obligations is marked speculative.

Jumps inside one register (forum shopping, escalation from one court to another, a change of room without a change of rules) are outside, and so are reframings and metaphors that describe a situation differently without changing who may speak, what counts as a move, or what closes the matter.

Whether 'register' is one thing across law, medicine, family, work, and trade, or only a family of resemblances, the map does not settle; it stipulates a register as a set of rules for speakers, moves, and closes, and every item is read against that stipulation.

seriation.axis: Whose hand the carrier is in: from carriers the weaker party owns outright and no room can confiscate (a body, a first person, a calendar, a question the holder is bound to answer), through carriers the weaker party can bring but the room must complete (a laugh, a kinship sentence, a written reply, a third body, a second), through carriers lent by a counterparty or an institution (the party owed, the instrument, the contract clause, the state, the archive), to carriers only the holder of the room owns (the meeting's question, the manual, the received feeling, the fee).
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of power or a count of how often each jump is made. Collapse in the dock opens it because nothing can be taken from a body except by force; One-way fine closes it because the fee is the holder's alone and, once set, cannot be handed back. The hinge is Bring a friend → Duel's seconds: one body brought into the room turns talk into testimony, and two bodies who confer on terms turn testimony into a rule, so the witness jump passes into the ceremonial one without anyone intending a ceremony, and the weaker party's carrier (a friend) becomes an institution's (a code). A second adjacency teaches from the far end: Call the police and Written for the future court are the two jumps addressed to a party not in the room, the state now and the archive later, and the first takes the case away while the second leaves the loser holding it. The four room-holder jumps that close the walk share a shape the walk conceals: each moves the matter without anyone saying which register it is now in, which is why Am I being detained? sits near the start as their counter.

exploration.first_question: What carries a situation from one register to another, what can the new register do that the old could not, and what is lost in transit?
exploration.changed_question: Whose hand is the carrier in, and which jumps force the holder to declare a register rather than offer one? Breath one wrote every jump as a move anyone in the situation could make; writing the discriminators showed that most weaker-party jumps are proposals the room completes (the joke needs the laugh, the kinship question needs the clinician to answer as kin, the request in writing needs the stronger party to write), and that the room-holder's jumps are mostly refusals to declare (the manual, the received feeling, the meeting's question move the matter without naming where it went).

priorities.item: Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.
priorities.why: It is the only weaker-party jump on the map that works by making the holder pay, and its reach is stated as exactly the reach of the rule that binds the holder to answer, which is a claim an operator can check against records rather than argue about.
priorities.next_question: Collect twenty recorded encounters in which the weaker party asked which register they were in (traffic stops, workplace 'is that an order', clinic 'is this required'), and for each note whether the holder answered with a declaration, with a manual, or with silence, and whether a rule binding them to answer existed; the map predicts declaration only where the rule exists and the manual as the standard escape everywhere else.

priorities.item: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since no room may continue its business past an unattended body; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; the one register entrance no permission can deny to the weakest party, and unlike the fire alarm, which anyone may pull and which a fine guards, this one is guarded by the discount every later collapse suffers.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that any room has fully abolished the body's override, high generative promise: the emergency register is entered from below by a body and from above by a declaration, and finding rooms that have ruled the bottom door shut would show what a register must pay to have only one door.
priorities.next_question: Find three rooms that have written the collapse out, the exam that continues past a fainting candidate, the chamber that votes over the member carried out, the trading floor that keeps the book open through a heart attack, and write for each what the room pays to keep its register, who is allowed to leave to tend the body, and whether the body's override returns the moment a second body fails.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference

neighbors.left: The room's laugh: a claim becomes survivable when it is delivered as a joke and the room laughs, as a junior surgeon's 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' says what a memo could not; the new register lets the unsayable be said in the presence of the party it is about and cannot be answered as a claim, since whoever answers becomes the one who could not take a joke, and what is lost is the remedy, because a joker who later presses the claim seems to renege on the laugh; not low-chair-advantages' Fool's license, which is a standing discount on a chair, but a discount applied to one sentence and paid for by the room, so the jump is proposed by the weaker party and completed by the room, and a joke nobody laughs at lands as a claim, and a worse one; 'only joking' runs the same carrier backward after the room has answered.
neighbors.right: Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted and so cannot be paid out; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.
neighbors.separating_case: A nurse tells the ward round 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' and nobody laughs; the sentence is now a claim, and a worse one than a memo, and the nurse is exposed. Had she said 'the last field I saw like that was on my first ward, and we lost the patient', nobody needs to laugh: the story stands without the room's help. The joke is completed by the room and the story by its teller, which is why the story sits below the joke on the itinerary although both are the weaker party's, and why a joker's fallback is a story and not a claim.

checks.boundary_case: Reframing in the consultant's sense is out: calling a layoff 'a transition' changes the vocabulary and nothing about who may speak, what counts as a move, or what closes the matter, so the layoff proceeds in the same register under a new name. Grievance stamp is in on exactly that contrast, since the word 'grievance' triggers a clause and a clause changes the moves; a word with no clause behind it is a metaphor, and metaphors are not jumps.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals: Whose desk and Let the number say it sit far apart on the itinerary, but the edge between them says the staffing read and the measurement read chase one bug around, each re-registering the other's residue. It shows a fork at Am I being detained? → Policy says: the forcing question has two exits, a declaration the holder must own or a manual that refuses to declare, and the sequence shows only the first. It shows a passage between levels at Bring a friend → Duel's seconds, where a witness becomes a second and a friend becomes a code. It shows an incompatibility at Wallet away → One-way fine, marked speculative, where the two price jumps are not inverses because one opens a door the other bricks up. And it shows a degradation at Call the police → Written for the future court, where the present-tense jump to the state, if refused, becomes the future-tense jump to the archive.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a carrier, what the new register can do, what is lost in transit, and whose hand the carrier is in, and the strange members (a body as the one entrance no permission can deny, a question that makes the holder pay for ambiguity, a fee that bricks up the gift door, a dissent addressed to a court that does not exist) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about choosing one's frame; where an item borders an admitted map (Fool's license, Invoice that ends the favor) the discriminator says what it adds.
